units.id: mission:Successors: Unified Defense|You notice after landing here that the spaceport crew is making no effort to refuel or repair your ship, and that a large contingent of Successor military officers is gathering around your landing pad, their weapons trained on your vessel. As several interceptors begin to hover over your ship as well with their weapons ready, you are forced to take off.|416|0
units.english: You notice after landing here that the spaceport crew is making no effort to refuel or repair your ship, and that a large contingent of Successor military officers is gathering around your landing pad, their weapons trained on your vessel. As several interceptors begin to hover over your ship as well with their weapons ready, you are forced to take off.
units.raw: `You notice after landing here that the spaceport crew is making no effort to refuel or repair your ship, and that a large contingent of Successor military officers is gathering around your landing pad, their weapons trained on your vessel. As several interceptors begin to hover over your ship as well with their weapons ready, you are forced to take off.`

units.id: mission:Successors: Unified Defense|	You soon receive a transmission routed through the local spaceport.
